summaries.demographer: Sean Buckley is a 50-year-old married white male living in Livingston, Montana, with his wife Megan and teenage son Owen, while his daughter Claire attends Montana State in Bozeman (Q05, Q51, Q84, Q89). He was born and raised in Dubuque, Iowa, in a stable two-parent working-class household with Irish-American Catholic roots (Q01, Q87, Q97, Q98, Q99). He has an associate degree in computer information systems and works as a senior software developer with stable salaried employment and employer health insurance (Q65, Q72, Q76). His household is economically stable, owns a mortgaged home, and manages rising costs, college expenses, and retirement planning through budgeting and savings (Q58, Q61, Q83).
summaries.behavioral_economist: Sean shows high planning orientation, risk aversion, and preference for durable, reliable outcomes over status consumption, as seen in his budget spreadsheets, relocation planning, emergency savings, and reluctance to finance discretionary travel with credit (Q03, Q17, Q61, Q62). His spending choices prioritize household stability, health insurance, home maintenance, college support, and modest outdoor or craft hobbies, while he cuts restaurants, beer tastings, tools, and travel first under pressure (Q57, Q60, Q63). He responds to uncertainty by gathering information, structuring decisions, and preserving option value, whether in career moves, health decisions, or software architecture (Q02, Q42, Q65). His time preferences are balanced: he invests in future certification and retirement but protects present family time and outdoor life (Q17, Q78, Q108).
summaries.political_scientist: Sean is a habitual voter and moderate Independent who currently leans closer to Democrats while retaining ticket-splitting and pragmatic local judgment (Q23, Q95, Q96). His civic orientation emphasizes competent administration, public lands, schools, health care access, institutional trust, and accountability rather than ideological purity (Q24, Q25). He supports police accountability and data transparency while keeping a local, systems-oriented view of reform (Q26, Q27). His community attachment is strong and enacted through library volunteering, neighborhood reciprocity, and interest in local tech workshops (Q07, Q08, Q108).
summaries.psychologist: Sean presents as conscientious, methodical, introverted, and reliability-centered, with a self-concept built around useful work, family responsibility, craft, and stable routines (Q01, Q16, Q109). He copes with stress through lists, outdoor activity, woodworking, structured problem-solving, and direct support from Megan rather than public emotional disclosure (Q43, Q44, Q49, Q50). He has anxious tendencies under uncertainty but no diagnosed depression or anxiety, and he monitors warning signs such as poor sleep and irritability (Q45). Relationally, he is loyal and practical, connecting through shared tasks, showing up consistently, and maintaining a small but trusted social circle (Q05, Q07, Q19).
